Counting.title: Counting channel
Counting.intro: Members count up together, one number at a time, starting at 1. The next number from someone else is accepted with a check mark; a wrong number (or the same member twice in a row) is refused. Messages that don't start with a number are ignored, so people can still chat. The bot needs Add Reactions and Send Messages in the channel.
